item.title: Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI
item.description:
Architect Labs introduced Frostbite, an AI-designed CPU that runs interaction nets in hardware. Agents took it from theory to 7 nm GDS, and pre-silicon tests show 4.59x performance per watt over an in-order core.

The post Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
item.description:
Meta has detailed TLX, its Triton Low-Level Extensions that add warp-group, barrier, TMA and cluster control to Python Triton kernels. It runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell and AMD MI350 GPUs.

The post Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
item.description:
NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B-class reasoning vision-language-action model that plans driving trajectories and explains them on DRIVE AGX Thor, at 160 to 190 ms pixel-to-trajectory latency.

The post NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries
item.description:
Google launched Gemini API Tool Retrieval in preview. Agents keep a large tool library on standby and load each parameter schema only when needed, inside one Interactions API request.

The post Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
item.description:
TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more.

The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
item.description:
Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer with 3.4B active parameters. It runs on a 32GB Mac or one DGX Spark and scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

The post Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
item.description:
OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API. The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, and a new standby mode bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05.

The post OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
item.description:
Baseten released bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4. bison-1 scores 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, and both models support 128k context and image input.

The post Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.
